content.comment_body: Hello everyone, The [product_name] user interface does not load after entering credentials on Google Chrome. I tried Microsoft Edge and Safari on my phone, and it worked in both. Why does Google Chrome prevent access? I experienced this on another PC as well. Thanks in advance

Hello [user_name], Please ensure that the access for [product_name] is enabled and review your access control settings. Have you tried testing this directly on the device? Which firmware version does your [product_name] have?
Hello [user_name], I deleted the cache and now the interface loads properly.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced issues with the [product_name] user interface failing to load after login on Google Chrome, whereas it worked normally on Edge and Safari. The problem occurred on multiple PCs and was resolved by clearing the browser cache, suggesting a compatibility or caching issue related to Google Chrome and impacting reliable browser access for [product_name].
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable and seamless access to the [product_name] interface from any browser, without encountering issues requiring troubleshooting actions like clearing the cache.
